rows.text: The Vannesians are renowned for their extraordinary musical talent, having been ranked among the top five most musically-gifted species in the universe. They communicate through beautiful chords and rejected the invitation from the Harmony Family, solely to pursue the pure beauty of rhythm. However, after receiving the Abundance's blessing, this pursuit began to turn pathological. For instance, in their pursuit of flawless vocal reproduction, the Vannesians used biotechnology to create these biological headsets with living mouths integrated into the earpads, which perform the audio directly, eliminating any timbral distortion.
